segments.ja331:1.1: Yo ve kāle asampatte, ativelaṃ pabhāsati;
segments.ja331:1.3: Evaṃ so nihato seti, kokilāyiva atrajo.
segments.ja331:2.1: Na hi satthaṃ sunisitaṃ, visaṃ halāhalāmiva [halāhalaṃ iva (pī.)];
segments.ja331:2.3: Evaṃ nikaṭṭhe [nikkaḍḍhe (syā.), nikaḍḍhe (ka.)] pāteti, vācā dubbhāsitā yathā.
segments.ja331:3.1: Tasmā kāle akāle vā [akāle ca (sī. syā.)], vācaṃ rakkheyya paṇḍito;
segments.ja331:4.1: Yo ca kāle mitaṃ bhāse, matipubbo vicakkhaṇo;
